subject: PlaneGeometry
question:
A rectangular strip of paper is folded in half three times, with each fold line parallel to the short edges. It is then unfolded so that the seven folds up or down can all be seen. Which of the following strips, viewed from a long edge, could not be made in this way? <image1>
Choices:
A:A
B:B
C:C
D:D
E:E
